description: Header file defining macros, constants, and function prototypes related to memory page management in jemalloc, including page size calculations, purging support, and huge page handling.

methods.name: pages_map
methods.description: Maps a memory page with specified address, size, and alignment, returning a pointer to the mapped memory.

methods.name: pages_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps a previously mapped memory page.

methods.name: pages_commit
methods.description: Commits memory pages, making them accessible.

methods.name: pages_decommit
methods.description: Decommits memory pages, releasing physical memory.

methods.name: pages_purge_lazy
methods.description: Performs lazy purging of memory pages.

methods.name: pages_purge_forced
methods.description: Performs forced purging of memory pages.

methods.name: pages_huge
methods.description: Checks if the memory region is a huge page.

methods.name: pages_nohuge
methods.description: Checks if the memory region is not a huge page.

methods.name: pages_dontdump
methods.description: Marks memory pages to not be dumped.

methods.name: pages_dodump
methods.description: Marks memory pages to be dumped.

methods.name: pages_set_thp_state
methods.description: Sets the transparent huge page (THP) state for a memory region.
